access_history.inspected:
[AUD-BLIND-R8-AF-001-001] Blind reconstruction | full | Publication date unknown

[FU-R8-AF-001-02] Follow-up research | full | 2020-11-29
Reporter saw troops by Hamdayet and heard accounts of blocked relatives. Government had not responded to repeated requests for comment; later statements encouraged return but did not explain the obstruction order.
